title: Dependency audit
objectives: Confirm the SBOM covers every manifest in the snapshot.
Record the vulnerability-intelligence assessment state per manifest.
Plan upgrades for advisories matched against loaded data.
Record NOT_ASSESSED gaps honestly instead of treating them as clean.

scope.notes: No-host scope: manifest and lockfile evidence only. No package is installed or executed during the audit. An empty advisory list means not assessed or not matched — never a clean bill of health.
